verdict.rationale: Founder Law's own materials cover O-1A, H-1B (transfers and lottery), TN, E-3 and L-1, and green-card paths (EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-2 NIW, marriage-based), plus International Entrepreneur Parole. A strategy session and roadmap help founders choose the pathway that fits their timeline. However, the evidence never mentions E-2 or cap-exempt H-1B routes, both of which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: E-2 treaty-investor coverage, cap-exempt H-1B routes, in-depth comparative guidance across options, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation
